prompt: Create a vibrant vertical anime illustration of a cheerful elf safari girl in a sunlit African savanna, shown from mid-thigh upward in a dynamic close-up pose. She has long flowing golden blonde twin-tails, pointed elf ears, bright green eyes, a wide open shouting smile, and both hands cupped around her mouth as if calling out loudly. Her outfit is a lion-inspired tribal safari costume: a fur-trimmed cropped top with warm brown geometric patterns, a central sculpted lion-head ornament on the chest, tooth-and-bead necklace, layered bracelets, leather armband, patterned sash, black belt, frayed denim short shorts, thigh leather strap, and fluffy fur leg cuffs. Emphasize a joyful, energetic expression and wind-swept hair ribbons, with glossy high-detail anime rendering, sharp linework, warm skin highlights, dramatic sunlight, and saturated colors. The background is a wide savanna under a vivid blue sky with puffy white clouds, a blazing sun with lens flare in the upper left, acacia trees on the right, golden grasslands, rocks in the foreground, and distant plains. Include exactly 7 visible animals in the scene: 2 giraffes at the left, 1 elephant in the mid-right distance, 1 zebra in the right foreground, and 3 small birds flying in the sky. Use a low-angle heroic composition, cinematic depth, detailed textures on fur, beads, leather, denim, and patterned fabric, with the character centered and filling most of the frame. No text, no watermark, no border.
